claims: The Madison is a 2026 Paramount+ drama series.
The Madison was created by Taylor Sheridan.
The Madison follows a wealthy New York family relocating to the Montana Madison River valley after a tragedy.
The Madison is a Yellowstone universe spinoff.
The Madison premiered with three episodes on March 14, 2026 on Paramount+.
The Madison focuses on Stacy Clyburn and her family leaving NYC for the Montana wilderness.
Michelle Pfeiffer plays Stacy Clyburn in The Madison.
Kurt Russell plays Preston in The Madison.
Matthew Fox plays Paul in The Madison.
Patrick J. Adams plays Russell McIntosh in The Madison.
Beau Garrett plays Abigail Reese in The Madison.
Elle Chapman plays Paige McIntosh in The Madison.
The Madison is part of the broader Yellowstone universe.
The Madison is not a direct prequel or sequel.
It is reported that Dutton family characters do not appear in The Madison.
The Madison was produced by MTV Entertainment Studios.
The Madison was produced by 101 Studios.
The Madison was produced by Bosque Ranch Productions.
